terms.definitionEn: Words in an image attribute that provide its useful meaning when it cannot be seen.
terms.definitionAr: كلمات في خاصية الصورة بتوضح معناها المفيد لما ما تكونش ظاهرة.

terms.definitionEn: A programmatic name and visible description associated with a form control.
terms.definitionAr: اسم ووصف ظاهر مرتبطين بأداة إدخال في النموذج.

terms.definitionEn: The text assistive technology uses to identify an interactive element.
terms.definitionAr: النص اللي التقنية المساعدة بتستخدمه عشان تعرف اسم العنصر التفاعلي.

terms.definitionEn: A semantic page region that helps assistive-technology users navigate major content areas.
terms.definitionAr: منطقة معنوية في الصفحة بتساعد مستخدمي التقنية المساعدة يتنقلوا بين الأقسام الرئيسية.

terms.definitionEn: The ability to operate interactive content using keys without requiring a pointer.
terms.definitionAr: إمكانية استخدام العناصر التفاعلية بالمفاتيح من غير الاعتماد على الماوس.

terms.definitionEn: An ARIA attribute that supplies a text name when visible text does not provide one.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية ARIA بتضيف اسمًا نصيًا لما مافيش نص ظاهر بيوفره.

terms.definitionEn: An attribute that communicates an element's meaning to accessibility APIs.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتوضح دور العنصر للواجهات اللي بتستخدمها أدوات الإتاحة.

terms.definitionEn: The sequence in which keyboard focus moves among focusable elements.
terms.definitionAr: الترتيب اللي التركيز بيتحرك بيه بين العناصر القابلة للتركيز بالمفاتيح.

terms.definitionEn: Markup that uses elements according to the purpose they communicate.
terms.definitionAr: كتابة بتستخدم العناصر حسب المعنى والدور اللي بتوضحه.

terms.definitionEn: A visual resource adding no information beyond nearby content and sometimes using alt="".
terms.definitionAr: صورة مش بتضيف معلومة جديدة وممكن تستخدم alt فاضي.

terms.definitionEn: A visible cue showing which interactive element currently receives keyboard input.
terms.definitionAr: علامة ظاهرة بتبين أنهي عنصر تفاعلي واخد تركيز لوحة المفاتيح حاليًا.

terms.definitionEn: A set of attributes that can add accessibility semantics when native HTML is insufficient.
terms.definitionAr: مجموعة خصائص ممكن تضيف معاني للإتاحة لما HTML الأصلي ما يكفيش.

questions.question: What does the alt value provide for this image?
options: Text that conveys useful image information
A visible caption automatically placed below the image
A second high-resolution image file
A link destination for the image
questions.explanation: Alternative text conveys useful image information when a user cannot perceive the image.
questions.explanationAr: النص البديل بيوصل معلومة الصورة المفيدة لما المستخدم ما يقدرش يشوفها.

questions.question: What accessibility benefit does this label provide?
options: It forces the control to accept only alphabetic letters
It names the control and can be clicked to focus it
It submits the form as soon as the label is activated
It makes the input invisible to screen readers
questions.explanation: A correctly associated label names its control and can be activated to focus it.
questions.explanationAr: الـ label المرتبط بيدي الأداة اسمًا وممكن الضغط عليه للتركيز عليها.

options: ? Close dialog
No visible text
Close dialog
aria-label
questions.explanation: The visible words remain unchanged, while aria-label supplies an accessible name.
questions.explanationAr: aria-label بيدي الزر اسمه للإتاحة، والرمز بيفضل النص الظاهر.

questions.prompt: Associate the visible label with the input whose id is email.
questions.explanation: A label's for value should match its control's id.

questions.question: How can main help people navigate the page?
options: It marks the page's main content region
It automatically makes every link open in a new tab
It replaces the need for page headings
It hides repeated navigation from every user
questions.explanation: main identifies the page's dominant content and exposes a useful landmark.
questions.explanationAr: main بيحدد المحتوى الأساسي وبيوفر landmark مفيد للتنقل.

questions.prompt: Mark the ornament as decorative because it adds no information.
questions.explanation: An empty alt value can keep a decorative image from adding redundant content.

questions.question: What native interaction does a button provide?
options: It can only be activated with a mouse click
It receives focus only after a script adds tabindex
It is announced as a text input by assistive technology
Keyboard-operable with button semantics
questions.explanation: A native button is keyboard-operable and exposes its interactive role without recreating that behavior manually.
questions.explanationAr: الزر الأصلي بيتستخدم بالمفاتيح وبيعلن دوره من غير إعادة بناء السلوك.

questions.expectedOutput:
City guide
Old town
Visitor desk
questions.explanation: The text appears in header, main, and footer order.
questions.explanationAr: النص بيظهر بترتيب header وبعده main وبعده footer.

questions.prompt: Provide a clear accessible name for this symbol-only button.
questions.explanation: aria-label supplies an accessible name without changing the visible symbol.

questions.question: What does the aria-label distinguish on this navigation region?
options: It changes the destination of every link inside the region
It names the landmark for assistive technology
It forces the region to appear before the main content
It prevents keyboard focus from reaching its links
questions.explanation: A name can distinguish a navigation landmark from other navigation regions.
questions.explanationAr: الاسم بيساعد يميز منطقة التنقل دي عن مناطق تنقل تانية.

questions.prompt: Use the native interactive element for an action that opens a menu.
questions.explanation: A native button already supports keyboard interaction and button semantics.

options:
Route map
separator.svg
separator.svg
Route map
No visible text
questions.explanation: The decorative image has an empty alternative and adds no image text.
questions.explanationAr: الصورة الزخرفية لها نص بديل فاضي ومش بتضيف نص للصورة.

questions.question: What does the status role communicate about this region?
options: It turns the region into a required form field
It makes the region a top-level page heading
It automatically moves keyboard focus to the region
It announces a changing status
questions.explanation: A status role is a live region for advisory information and should not unexpectedly move focus.
questions.explanationAr: role=status بيعلن رسائل الحالة كمنطقة حية من غير نقل التركيز فجأة.

questions.prompt: Mark the complementary note related to the main article.
questions.explanation: aside can identify complementary content related to its surrounding region.
The label and the input's displayed initial value contribute readable text.
questions.explanationAr: الـ label والقيمة المبدئية الظاهرة في أداة الإدخال بيكونوا نصًا مقروءًا.

questions.prompt: Add an accessible name to this icon-only button without changing its symbol.
questions.explanation: aria-label names an interactive element while leaving its visible content unchanged.

questions.question: What should happen when a keyboard user moves through these controls?
options: A logical, visible focus order
The link should be skipped because it is not a button
The browser should focus only the last control
Tab order should match the order of CSS colors
questions.explanation: A logical focus order and visible focus indicator help keyboard users track and operate controls.
questions.explanationAr: ترتيب تركيز منطقي وعلامة تركيز ظاهرة بيساعدوا مستخدم لوحة المفاتيح.

questions.prompt: Identify this element as a polite live status message.
questions.explanation: The status role conveys a non-interruptive status update.

questions.question: What should an empty alternative mean for a decorative image?
options: The image is unavailable and should display its file path
When it adds no unique information
The browser should repeat the adjacent paragraph aloud
The image must be hidden using CSS from every user
questions.explanation: An empty alternative is appropriate when the image is decorative and contributes no distinct information.
questions.explanationAr: النص البديل الفاضي مناسب لما الصورة زخرفية ومش بتضيف معلومة مستقلة.

questions.prompt: Give this navigation landmark a distinguishing name.
questions.explanation: A concise name distinguishes this landmark from other navigation regions.

questions.question: How should you decide what text to put in an image's alt attribute?
keyPoints: Describe the image's relevant information in context
Use an empty value for purely decorative images
Do not use the filename as a substitute for a useful description
questions.modelAnswer: Write alternative text that conveys the image's relevant information in its context, without repeating nearby content. If the image is purely decorative, an empty value can keep it from adding noise.

questions.question: When is ARIA useful, and why should native HTML semantics come first?
keyPoints: ARIA can add names, states, or roles when needed
Native elements already provide built-in behavior
ARIA does not automatically implement keyboard interaction
Prefer native HTML when it expresses the required meaning
questions.modelAnswer: ARIA can communicate names, roles, and states when native HTML does not express a needed meaning. Native controls should come first because they already include expected semantics and interaction behavior that ARIA alone does not create.

questions.question: What makes a page usable with a keyboard alone?
keyPoints: Focus order follows a sensible sequence
Controls can be operated without a pointer
questions.modelAnswer: Every interactive control should be reachable and operable without a pointer, with focus moving in a sensible order. A visible focus indicator lets users see where their next action will apply.

questions.question: How do semantic landmarks improve navigation for assistive-technology users?
keyPoints: Users can jump between named regions
Landmarks complement a useful heading structure
questions.modelAnswer: Landmarks identify regions such as main content and navigation so assistive-technology users can move between them directly. They complement headings by providing both broad page structure and a hierarchy within each region.
